snippet.description:
India’s telecom sector is preparing for its next technology shift as Reliance Jio advances its 6G ambitions. At India Mobile Congress 2026, Jio showcased its pre-6G technology stack and Giga MIMO Radio, signalling a growing focus on developing next-generation networks within India.

snippet.description:
At its height, British India held around 300 million people, and the elite civil service that ran it numbered only about a thousand men. So how did so few control so many?

The answer is on the map. Over 560 princely states, each ruled by its own prince, loyal to the Crown. An army where most soldiers were Indian sepoys. Railways and telegraph lines that pulled the whole subcontinent toward Calcutta and Bombay. And a quiet rule: divide, and keep it divided.

One small island, one vast subcontinent. Watch how it worked.

snippet.title: FREE Ambulance Service in India JUST STOPPED FULLY! - Blinkit Made It CHARGEABLE #shorts
snippet.description:
Blinkit has introduced a ₹2,500 charge for non-emergency ambulance transfers after reporting increasing use of its free service for routine journeys. Emergency transfers will continue to remain free, meaning the company has changed its pricing policy rather than stopped the ambulance service. Company News

Announcing the decision on November 5, Eternal founder Deepinder Goyal said bookings increasingly included routine checkups, hospital visits and hospital-to-home transfers that could have been handled by other transport.

According to Goyal, these trips occupy fully equipped ambulances and trained paramedics who might otherwise respond to life-threatening situations. The new fee, collected after a non-emergency trip, is intended to discourage such usage and preserve emergency availability.

Goyal said the service had handled approximately 42,000 cases, including around 20,000 emergencies, without charging users. Revenue from the new fee will go to the Eternal Foundation, which operates the ambulances, and help support expansion.

The announcement has prompted debate about responsible use of free services. Some social media users supported charging for routine transfers, while others questioned how the company would decide whether a booking qualifies as an emergency. The announcement did not provide detailed classification criteria.

Expansion also faces a staffing challenge. Goyal identified the availability of trained, empathetic paramedics as a major constraint, while outlining ambitions to reach all major Indian cities over the next two to four years.

For Indian users, the key distinction is between emergency assistance and routine medical transport. Free emergency trips remain part of the service wherever it operates; nationwide availability has not been announced.

snippet.title: 100% ‘REAL Gold’ Used in Ramayana Movie? Bollywood’s Most Expensive Facts #shorts
snippet.description:
Ranbir Kapoor’s Ramayana, released on November 5, is making headlines for the extraordinary preparation behind its visuals. Two production details have emerged: Ravana’s throne was finished with real 24-carat gold leafing, while the Ravana–Jatayu battle took six and a half years to develop, according to the filmmakers.

Art director Ramesh revealed that the throne used by Yash’s Ravana took approximately four months to construct and cost around ₹1 crore. Artisans first created a clay model, prepared a mould and built the structure using fibre before applying the gold finish. Gold leafing uses extremely thin sheets of real gold over another material; the throne itself was not solid gold. 

Director Nitesh Tiwari separately explained that the Jatayu battle’s lengthy timeline covered the journey from the initial artist briefing to the finished sequence. It represents years of conceptualisation, design changes and visual-effects work, rather than six years of continuous filming. Thousands of people contributed to bringing the sequence to the screen.

A major challenge involved designing the Pushpak Viman. The team explored roughly 40–50 designs and spent close to two years settling on its appearance. Changes to the flying vehicle subsequently required revisions to the aerial confrontation between Ravana and Jatayu.

Ranbir also highlighted the effort of visual-effects artists, expressing disappointment when their work is casually dismissed as AI-generated. Together, these accounts offer Indian audiences a clearer picture of the physical craftsmanship and digital production behind the film’s ambitious retelling of the epic.

snippet.title: FAKE GOLD is 'New Normal' in Diwali! BEWARE Indians in Shopping! #shorts
snippet.description:
A fresh enforcement action against counterfeit hallmarked jewellery has highlighted the need for careful checks during India’s Dhanteras and Diwali shopping season. On November 4, the Bureau of Indian Standards seized approximately 19 grams of gold jewellery bearing fake BIS hallmarks from a shop in Chatrapur, Odisha.

According to BIS, the establishment lacked valid registration under its Hallmarking Scheme. Further legal action is being initiated. The case concerns counterfeit certification marks; it does not establish that every seized item contained no gold.

For families spending savings on festive jewellery, a stamped symbol alone should not end the verification process. Hallmarked gold jewellery carries three identifying elements: the BIS logo, a purity mark such as 22K916, and a six-character alphanumeric Hallmark Unique Identification code, or HUID. 

Buyers can enter this code in the official BIS CARE app using “Verify HUID.” The displayed information should match the article being purchased. BIS says recent digital upgrades also provide photographs and recorded weight for applicable records, helping customers compare the physical jewellery with its registered details.

Consumers should also check the jeweller’s BIS registration and obtain a proper invoice describing the purchase. Keeping that bill matters if a dispute arises over purity or misleading certification.

Anyone concerned about an item’s purity can approach a BIS-recognised Assaying and Hallmarking Centre for testing. BIS also provides compensation provisions when hallmarked jewellery is found below its declared purity.

During the festive rush, checking the HUID before payment can help Indian households protect both their purchase and their trust in the seller.

snippet.title: Imagine Waking Up & Your Bank Is DEAD - 3 Million Bank Accounts gONE - Paraguay #shorts
snippet.description:
Paraguay’s Ueno Bank has been placed into resolution after regulators identified a severe capital shortfall, disrupting access to money for customers of a digital lender claiming approximately 30 lakh users. The crisis has raised concerns over personal savings, public funds and banking oversight.

The country’s central bank said its board ordered the resolution process on November 2 after Ueno’s solvency ratio fell below half the legally required minimum. Resolution allows authorities to manage a failing bank, preserve assets and organise protection for depositors.

However, saying that millions of people have permanently lost all their money would misrepresent the situation. Restricted access to accounts is different from a confirmed final loss, and authorities have announced a phased repayment process.

On November 5, the central bank outlined an initial payment stage for eligible customers with deposits totalling up to 10 million guaraníes, no debts to Ueno and an account at another bank or finance company. Qualifying depositors were told they would receive their full eligible balances.

The regulator stated that deposit guarantees extend to 228.3 million guaraníes per depositor per institution, subject to the applicable rules. Larger balances remain subject to the resolution process. Officials also described Ueno’s problems as an isolated case, rather than evidence of system-wide banking failure.

For Indian readers, the episode highlights deposit-insurance limits. In India, DICGC covers eligible deposits up to ₹5 lakh per depositor per insured bank, including principal and interest held in the same right and capacity. Multiple accounts at the same bank do not automatically multiply that protection.

snippet.title: How to grow lucky bamboo the right way!
snippet.description:
Lucky bamboo Care Guide Here: 

Soil: Use a well-draining potting mix. Regular houseplant mix with a little perlite works well. The pot needs a drainage hole.

Watering: Keep the soil lightly moist but never soggy. Water when the top inch feels dry, which is usually about once a week.

Water quality: It’s sensitive to the fluoride and chlorine in tap water, which cause yellow or brown tips. Use filtered, distilled, or rain water, or let tap water sit out overnight.

Light: Bright, indirect light. Direct sun scorches the leaves, and low light makes the stalks stretch and fade.

Temperature: 65–90°F. Keep it away from AC vents and drafts.

Fertilizer: Feed lightly with a diluted liquid houseplant fertilizer every 1–2 months in spring and summer. Too much burns the roots.

Humidity: Average indoor humidity is fine, but in dry Arizona air it’ll appreciate an occasional misting.

Switching from water to soil: Expect a few weeks of adjustment while the roots adapt. Keep the soil a bit wetter than usual during that time.

Pets: It’s toxic to cats and dogs, so keep it out of reach.

(Technically not even a bamboo, it’s a Dracaena)

snippet.title: 🏭 How Modeling Clay Is Mass Produced
snippet.description:
Ever wonder how massive blocks of vibrant modeling clay are transformed into perfect, uniform bricks for retail? Go behind the scenes of an industrial production line to witness the incredible precision required to manufacture these colorful clay products. From the initial extrusion process that layers the material into distinct sections to the automated cutting and high-speed packaging, this video captures every stage of the factory operation.

Observe the industrial machinery in action as it slices through dense clay with surgical precision, followed by the rapid flow-wrapping process that seals each unit. Watch the final step of the assembly line where skilled workers organize the finished products, ready for distribution. This satisfying look into modern manufacturing highlights the efficiency and engineering that go into creating everyday art supplies. If you enjoy watching complex machines at work or have a curiosity about factory automation, this detailed walkthrough provides a fascinating look at the lifecycle of a mass-produced product from raw material to final packaging.
